desc:
Our brand new house was making us sick. That lead me to study indoor air quality, and the findings were stunning. Besides the risk of making you physically sick, your mental capacity can take a serious hit. Here's what I learned.

(This presentation was delivered at the Basecamp company meetup in October 2018).
